Name: Persistent Game Options
Author: Xangriaa
Description:
[b][size=4]What it does:
[/size][/b][size=4][size=3]Persistent Game Options syncs your game options between save files. It also loads your previously saved options when starting a new game.

[color=#cc0000][size=4][b]Important!![/b][/size][/color]
[/size][/size][size=3]Your options are saved in a data.json file in the mod folder. Do [b]not[/b] edit this file. Editing the options outside of the game could cause crashes.

[/size][b][size=3]Note:
[/size][/b][size=3]This does not yet save keybinds, but that is planned for a future update. [/size]

Manifest.Name: PersistentGameOptions
Manifest.Description: Saves chosen game options between saves.
